NHT_VALID_RESOLVE_ENABLED.desc: Enable resolve_via_default for the default VRF, IPv4.

NHT_VALID_RESOLVE_DISABLED.desc: Disable resolve_via_default for the default VRF, IPv4.

NHT_VALID_RESOLVE_IPV6.desc: Set resolve_via_default for the default VRF, IPv6.

NHT_VALID_USER_VRF.desc: Set resolve_via_default for a user VRF from the VRF table.

NHT_VALID_MULTI_ROW.desc: Rows for both VRFs and both address families validate together.

NHT_VALID_KEYS_ONLY.desc: A row with only the list keys is valid; resolve_via_default has no YANG default.

NHT_NON_EXIST_VRF.desc: Referring a VRF name that is not in the VRF table.

NHT_INVALID_AFI.desc: Using an afi outside the ipv4/ipv6 enumeration.

NHT_INVALID_RESOLVE_VALUE.desc: Using a resolve_via_default value that is not a boolean.

NHT_DUPLICATE_KEY.desc: Duplicate (vrf_name, afi) key violates list uniqueness.
